containers.name: Food Caddy
containers.takes: All cooked and raw food, including meat, bones, dairy, eggshells, tea bags, coffee grounds, bread, fruit and vegetable peelings
containers.not: Packaging, liquids such as milk, nappies, pet waste or cat litter

containers.name: Green Boxes and Blue Bag (Recycling)
containers.frequency: Every two weeks, in the week your green bin isn't collected
containers.takes: Box one: plastic pots, tubs and bottles, tins, cans, foil and cartons. Box two: paper. Box three: glass bottles and jars. Blue bag: cardboard and brown paper
containers.not: Cards with glitter, and anything not listed above

containers.name: Plastic Bags and Wrapping (Recycling)
containers.frequency: Every two weeks, on your recycling day, for households that have signed up
containers.takes: Plastic carrier, bread, freezer and salad bags, sweet and chocolate wrappers, crisp and snack packets, cheese and meat wrapping, toilet roll and magazine wrap, pouches and sachets, film lids, bottle sleeves, bubble wrap, cling film and fruit and vegetable nets. Tie the full bag and put it in your recycling box

containers.name: Green Wheelie Bin (General Waste)
containers.frequency: Every two weeks, in the week your recycling isn't collected
containers.takes: Household rubbish that can't be recycled
containers.not: Garden waste, soil, rubble, building or DIY waste, electrical items, hazardous or clinical waste. Extra bags left beside the bin aren't collected

containers.name: Brown Bin (Garden Waste)
containers.frequency: Every two weeks for subscribers, with a four-week break over Christmas and New Year
containers.takes: Grass, hedge and shrub clippings, leaves, twigs, plants, weeds, windfall fruit and branches under 10cm across
containers.not: Soil, food, animal waste, large branches, plant pots and plastic bags

garden_waste.term: 12 months from the first of the month after your bin is delivered
